board.instructions: To move a card, focus it and press Space or M, choose a column with the left and right arrows, then press Enter. Escape cancels. Enter opens the card; the Move to menu lists every column.
board.pick: Moving {card} from {lane}. Left and right arrows choose a column, Enter drops, Escape cancels.
board.upDown: Use the left and right arrows to choose a column.
board.notMoved: {card} was not moved. It stays in {lane}.

lab.subject: Subject
lab.onlyManagers: Only quality managers close a nonconformance
lab.closeBody: Closing needs your signature. After that the nonconformance can no longer change; its decisions stay with the garments.
lab.readOnly: Read-only: only quality staff move nonconformances. You can look at them and open them.
lab.offline: Offline — this is the last copy, from 07:42. Changes wait to be sent.
lab.errorReason: The server did not answer in time. Nothing is drawn, so an empty board is never shown by mistake.
lab.emptyText: Every nonconformance is closed. A new one starts from an inspection, a hold or a complaint.
lab.noPermTitle: You need the permission to see nonconformances
lab.noPermText: A quality manager or an administrator grants it.
lab.opened: Enter or a click opens {card}: its record.
lab.more: Show more: the next page of {lane} is read.
lab.releaseBody: Releasing lets the goods move again. Another person than the one who placed the hold releases it, with the reason.
